scope: SDevice-only n23 HFS-off OldSlotboom BGN by SRH(DopingDependence) 2x2 causal ablation

factor_effects.bgn_main: average over SRH levels of BGN-on minus BGN-off
factor_effects.srh_main: average over BGN levels of SRH-on minus SRH-off

claim_policy: Only paired cross-solver factor effects may be used for causal attribution; a single ablated current is diagnostic only.
The M28 validated continuation route is fixed for every Sentaurus cell.
HFS remains disabled in every cell so its response cannot alias BGN or SRH effects.
No production BGN, SRH, mobility, contact, SG, or solver default may be changed from this audit alone.
